title: Native Plant Swap at Montgomery College
address: At the Food Forest, Montgomery College · 7719 Chicago Ave, SS
description:
1:00 PM to 3:00 PM

New to plant swaps? You don't need to bring anything (although a plate of cookies would be nice). Come learn, socialize, and take home some natives!
hosts: CAC, SSTP Aid Community Garden group, and the Community Food Forest Collective

title: Wild Ones National Capital Region — Plant Swap
description:
10:30 AM to 1:00 PM

Members Only Seed/Plant Swap
noteContent:
You must be a member of Wild Ones to attend.
Go to nationscapitalregion.wildones.org and near the bottom left is the button to join.
